columns.name: EVAL_RUN_ID
columns.description: Autogenerated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: EVAL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the FAI_EVALUATIONS table.

columns.name: TARGET_OBJ_STATE
columns.description: The state of the Workflow or Prompt used in the evaluation run.

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: Session ID related to the evaluation run.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Start time of the evaluation run.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: End time of the evaluation run.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The status of the evaluation run.

columns.name: EVAL_SPEC
columns.description: A snaphot of evaluation configurations in JSON format used for the evaluation run.

columns.name: MEDIAN_CORRECTNESS
columns.description: Median correctness of the evaluation run.

columns.name: MEDIAN_LATENCY
columns.description: Median latency of the evaluation run.

columns.name: ERROR_COUNT
columns.description: Error count of the evaluation run.

columns.name: INPUT_TOKENS_COUNT
columns.description: The number of input tokens in the evaluation run.

columns.name: OUTPUT_TOKENS_COUNT
columns.description: The number of output tokens in the evaluation run.

columns.name: JOBS_COUNT
columns.description: The number of jobs for the evaluation run.

columns.name: GROUNDEDNESS
columns.description: Correctness of the evaluation run

columns.name: ANSWER_RELEVANCE
columns.description: Answer relevance of the evaluation run

columns.name: CONTEXT_RELEVANCE
columns.description: Context relevance of the evaluation run

columns.name: COVERAGE
columns.description: Stores the coverage metrics of the evaluation run

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
